title: fix(runtime): read-only package refusals name the paired .custom route (#29568)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Q73GFHYZZiZPcJDf9b81wq)_
Fixes #29568

Clause-②: no (message text only)
Metadata-protocol: none

Measured on base and head: the same requests get the same status, `code`, `details`, doors and order. Only the message text changed (per-door table under Why).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只读包在 `/packages` 写入口被拒时（`422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` 共 7 个入口，加上 duplicate 的 `422 DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE`），提示语的补救办法换成 ADR-0146 的配对包路线：先 `POST /api/v1/packages/ID/ensure-customization`，再把条目存进 `ID.custom`（`?package=ID.custom`），要替换包里自带的条目就声明 `overrides: { package: 'ID', basedOn }`。`install-modes.mdx` 里讲托管安装后怎么定制的那一段也同步改了。
- **为什么改**：旧提示让人"按原名另存一份，作为环境级状态（ADR-0131 D6）"。自从 ADR-0146 D11 关掉了这条不带 package 的保存，照做会再吃一个 `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`，等于把人指进死胡同。
- **风险与回滚**：只改文字。状态码、`code`、`details`、哪些入口拒绝、拒绝顺序都不变，读 `code` 的客户端看不出差别。消息变长了（实测 747 到 771 字符，duplicate 1022 字符），这些入口不截断，实测整句返回。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `customizeInPairRemedy`；`packages/runtime/src/package-readonly-remedy-follow.integration.test.ts`；`content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx` 的 "What a managed install keeps" 一段。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/domains/packages-readonly-remedy-pair-route.test.ts src/package-readonly-remedy-follow.integration.test.ts`，预期 17 个全绿（16 个逐入口钉住新句子，1 个按新句子走通 ensure 加存入配对包，并验证这一条被服务出来）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The sentence.** `CUSTOMISE_BESIDE_REMEDY` (a constant) becomes `customizeInPairRemedy(id)` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, because the route names the package. For a package whose pair the pairing rule derives (`customizationPackageId`, `@objectstack/spec/kernel`), the sentence reads: "customize what it ships in its paired package 'ID.custom' (ADR-0146 D3): ensure it with POST /api/v1/packages/ID/ensure-customization, then save the item there (?package=ID.custom), declaring overrides: { package: 'ID', basedOn } to replace an item 'ID' ships. A type that takes no override, or a locked item, is refused naming its route or the lock; a package that cannot have a pair is refused at that door, naming why." The pair address and the declaration are spelled exactly as the save door's own close spells them (`packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`). For an id the rule derives no pair for, the sentence names the ensure door alone, and that door answers with the reason.
- **The sites.** These are the same two callers as before: `requireWritablePackage` (delete, disable, publish, revert, adopt-orphans, the manifest `PATCH`, an install with `overwrite`) and `requireDuplicableSource` (duplicate). The status, `code`, `details`, gate order and predicate are unchanged.
- **The doc blocks.** The block above the function, the `requireWritablePackage` history paragraph and the duplicate door's "two built answers" paragraph now name the pair, and the retired ADR-0131 D6 remedy is recorded as history.
- **The docs.** `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`, "What a managed install keeps", described the live refusal with the old model ("overlaid by saving one under the same name", "cloned under a new name"). It now describes the pair: the ensure door, a save naming the pair, the `overrides` declaration, the types that take no override, and the `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` on a package-less save. ADRs and CHANGELOGs are left as history.
- **Not touched.** `new-similar-target.ts` already names the pair (ADR-0146 D3). The Studio landing copy was #29489's (closed via #29537 before this card was triaged), and nothing there is touched. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/RefusalMessage.test.tsx` holds the old sentence as a frozen fixture. That fixture only tests how a refusal's lead sentence is split, it is outside this card's file surface, and it is listed under Acceptance notes.

## Why

The old remedy is a dead end, and the new route works for every kind of read-only base it promises. Measured on `main` @ `dbca3ef0`, showcase booted `--fresh`, an admin session, through the real routes:

<details><summary>Refusal sites on main (base)</summary>

| Door | Status / code | Message length |
|---|---|---|
| `DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase` | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` | 544 |
| `PATCH …/disable` | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` | 546 |
| `POST …/publish` | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` | 546 |
| `POST …/revert` | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` | 544 |
| `POST …/adopt-orphans` | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` | 564 |
| `PATCH /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase` | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` | 540 |
| `POST /api/v1/packages` (`overwrite: true`) | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` | 550 |
| `POST …/duplicate` | 422 `DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE` | 815 |

Every message ended with the ADR-0131 D6 sentence, untruncated.

On head (the same boot, the built branch): the same eight doors answer the same status, `code` and `details` (`packageId`, `docs`). The messages are 751 / 753 / 753 / 751 / 771 / 747 / 757 and 1,022 characters, each ending with the new sentence. Following it (ensure 201, the view saved into `com.example.showcase.custom` with `overrides` 200) serves the saved columns at `showcase_task.in_progress`.
</details>

<details><summary>The old remedy, followed: refused</summary>

`PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress` (no `?package`, the shipped body with a new label) answered `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`: "'view/showcase_task.in_progress' ships in 'com.example.showcase': save it into 'com.example.showcase.custom' (?package=com.example.showcase.custom), declaring overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn }. …". An installed app's view and dashboard got the same answer, naming that app's pair.
</details>

<details><summary>The new route, followed, per kind of read-only base</summary>

| Base | `POST …/ensure-customization` | Save into the pair (`?package=BASE.custom`) |
|---|---|---|
| `com.example.showcase` (code-booted app, namespace `showcase`) | 201 | view override 200, served at the base's name with the saved columns; flow override 200; a new view under its own name 200; action override 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("not yet available", ADR-0146 D9); permission override 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("takes no override", ADR-0146 D6, "new similar") |
| `com.acme.installed` (installed through `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, managed, namespace `acme`) | 201 | view override 200, dashboard override 200, both served at the base's name |
| `com.objectstack.setup` (platform, namespace `setup`) | 201 | `app/setup` 403 `ITEM_LOCKED` (vendor lock `full`) |
| `com.objectstack.plugin-auth` (platform, namespace `sys`) | 201 | not measured (ships no overridable item to try) |
| `com.objectstack.audit` (platform, the second `sys` namespace) | 422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, naming `com.objectstack.plugin-auth.custom` | none |
| `com.objectstack.platform-objects` (platform, no namespace) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, "declares no namespace" | none |

So the sentence promises the route, and it names the two ways the route can stop: the save door refuses a type with no override (or a locked item) naming its own route, and the ensure door refuses a base it cannot pair, naming why. It promises nothing beyond what was measured.
</details>

## Tests

- **New: `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-readonly-remedy-pair-route.test.ts`** (16). At each of the seven `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` doors, for a code-booted and a platform-scoped package, it checks the status, the code and the message prefix, and that the message ENDS with the whole new sentence, spelled out in the test. The duplicate door carries the whole sentence between its other two remedies, and the protocol is never called. The unpairable-id branch is covered too. Every case also asserts that the three phrases only the old sentence carried (`under its own name`, `environment-level state`, `ADR-0131 D6`) are absent. The new sentence contains none of them, so the old sentence cannot pass these checks.
- **New: `packages/runtime/src/package-readonly-remedy-follow.integration.test.ts`** (1). It boots `createStandaloneStack` over an artifact (a code-registered app with a dashboard) and drives the HTTP dispatcher's doors. `DELETE` answers 422 and the test reads the ensure route, the pair and the declared package out of the message. The control is the old remedy: a package-less `PUT` answers 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, names the pair, and nothing is served. Then it calls the ensure door the message names (201) and the declared save into the pair (200), and the item's name now serves the saved label.
- **Forced edits: `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-readonly-gate.test.ts`**, two pins that asserted `toContain('ADR-0131 D6')` (the duplicate envelope case and the #14451 "no dead end" case for DELETE and disable). They now assert the ensure route and the absence of `ADR-0131 D6`. Their other assertions are unchanged.
- **Ablation** (standard order item 5). The old sentence went back into `customizeInPairRemedy` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `5a50e54` → `e1e6091`), and three files ran: 20 failed, 22 passed. All 16 new pins, the integration test (`expected { ensureRoute: undefined, …(2) } to deeply equal { …(3) }`) and the three forced pins went red. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Runtime tests run from `src`, so no build or dist leg was needed.
- **Consumer suites.** No `packages/rest` test or dogfood test asserts this message text (`git grep` of the old phrases and of `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` message assertions over `packages/rest`, `packages/qa`: none; the one dogfood hit matches `code` only). So no rest or dogfood edit is forced. Dogfood is not owed: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Verification

All on head `c34c2e14`, in a card container:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (under the verify lock): **Test Files 527 passed (527) · Tests 8503 passed | 19 skipped (8522)**, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` scoped to the touched package (`eslint packages/runtime --no-inline-config`, the root config): exit 0. `content/docs` has no lint script, and the docs gates are in the list below.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 90 derived gates, each run after a full `turbo run build` of `./packages/**` and `./examples/**`, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "90 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". One gate, `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, first answered exit 3 because its pinned fixture commit was missing from this clone ("cannot read the positive control at 621a4876…"). That is a prerequisite, not a red. After `git fetch origin 621a4876…` it answered exit 0 (48 cases).
- Ablation and the live base/head measurements are under Tests and Why.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/RefusalMessage.test.tsx` keeps the old ADR-0131 D6 sentence as one of three "measured on Setup" fixtures for `splitRefusal`. It asserts only the lead sentence, which is unchanged ("Cannot publish package …: it is read-only (provided by code or an installed app)."), so it stays green and true about the split. The fixture text is now stale. Refreshing it is optional ui-lane tidying, left with the seat (#29489 is closed, so it carries nothing; contract review 6587839294 answered B, leave it).
- The messages are longer now: 747–771 characters at the seven `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` doors, 1,022 at duplicate (measured on head). The `/packages` doors return the whole message, with no 500-character bound on this path. This was already the case on main, where duplicate answered 815 characters whole.
